name: Podio
human_notes: Free account lets developers generate client ID and secret in API key settings.

name: Pipedrive
human_notes: Free developer sandbox account provides API tokens and OAuth app registration.

name: Zoho CRM
human_notes: Free tier and Zoho API Console provide immediate OAuth2 client credentials.

name: Zendesk
human_notes: Free trial and sponsored developer accounts allow immediate API token and OAuth setup.

name: Intercom
human_notes: Free Developer Workspace provides immediate access tokens for testing APIs.

name: Gorgias
human_notes: 7-day free trial provides REST API credentials (email + API key) in settings.

name: Discord
human_notes: Discord Developer Portal lets any user create an application and bot token immediately.

name: Slack
human_notes: Free workspace and api.slack.com allow immediate bot/user token and OAuth2 app creation.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
human_notes: Free account and Lark Open Platform allow creating custom apps with App ID/Secret immediately.

name: Google Ads
human_notes: Requires a Manager Account and an approved Developer Token application (Basic/Standard access review).

name: Meta Ads
human_notes: Development mode works on owned ad accounts, but accessing external accounts requires Meta App Review and Business Verification.

name: systeme.io
human_notes: Free plan includes public API key generation in profile settings.

name: Ecwid
human_notes: REST API access requires a paid Venture plan or higher (free tier excludes API).

name: WooCommerce
human_notes: Any WordPress/WooCommerce store admin can generate Consumer Key and Secret immediately.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
human_notes: Requires an enterprise SFCC customer or Salesforce Partner sandbox provisioned via Account Manager.

name: SE Ranking
human_notes: Data API and Project API require a paid Business subscription or Data API credit package.

name: Waterfall.io (contact/company intel)
human_notes: Requires requesting access / booking a demo for API credentials.

name: Bright Data
human_notes: Self-serve signup gives Bearer API token immediately; full web unlocker zones require KYC verification.

name: GitHub
human_notes: Free account lets developers create Personal Access Tokens (PATs) or GitHub Apps immediately.

name: Vercel
human_notes: Free Hobby account allows immediate Bearer token creation in Account Settings > Tokens.

name: Cloudflare
human_notes: Free account lets users create scoped API Tokens immediately in My Profile > API Tokens.

name: Harvest
human_notes: Free plan and 30-day trial allow generating Personal Access Tokens at id.getharvest.com/developers.

name: Notion
human_notes: Free workspace allows creating Internal Integrations with secret_ tokens immediately at notion.so/my-integrations.

name: ClickUp
human_notes: Free Forever plan lets users generate a Personal API Token (pk_...) in Settings > Apps.

name: Stripe
human_notes: Free signup immediately grants Sandbox / Test Mode sk_test_ API keys without business verification.

name: Paygent Connect (NMI-powered)
human_notes: Requires merchant/partner underwriting approval to obtain gateway security_key credentials.

name: PitchBook
human_notes: Enterprise license and paid API add-on required via PitchBook sales team.

name: YouTube Transcript (transcriptapi.com)
human_notes: Free tier signup provides an immediate API key for transcript extraction requests.

name: Fathom
human_notes: Free Fathom account allows generating an API key in Settings > API Access for recordings and transcripts.

name: Reducto
human_notes: Free signup grants immediate test credits and an API key in Studio.
